dashboard_item.raw_yaml:
title: Process and Service Enumeration via Command Shell
id: 8a036f03-b176-4eb3-b262-23b282e8c340
status: experimental
description: 'Suspicious powershell.exe Spawning cmd.exe (Windows command prompt started
  by an abnormal process) - Host WIN-5J23U7CAV7V.hvan.vn triggered sequence anomaly
  (token=''sysmon|1|process_create|powershell.exe>cmd.exe|system32|tiny_few'', score=0.9996):
  Image=cmd.exe, ParentImage=powers'
references:
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/003/
author: SigmaGen
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.t1059.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: \cmd.exe
    ParentImage|endswith: \powershell.exe
    CommandLine|contains: tasklist
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative activity
level: medium
dashboard_item.wazuh_xml:
<group name="ml_generated,sysmon,">
  <rule id="100150" level="8">
    <if_group>sysmon_event1</if_group>
    <field name="win.eventdata.image" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+cmd\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.parentImage" type="pcre2">(?i)\\+powershell\.exe$</field>
    <field name="win.eventdata.commandLine" type="pcre2">(?i)tasklist</field>
    <description>Process and Service Enumeration via Command Shell [Alert: AI-20261012_133213.176-c651951e8fc1]</description>
    <mitre>
      <id>T1059.003</id>
    </mitre>
  </rule>
</group>
